prs.title: fix(server): allow JSON Accept in JSON response mode
prs.author: Genmin
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP JSON response mode rejects requests whose Accept header lists only application/json (without also listing text/event-stream), even though the server only returns JSON in that mode. Both PRs diff from the identical base revision of src/server/webStandardStreamableHttp.ts and remove the same AND-based validation that required both media types to be present. (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Streamable HTTP JSON response mode rejects requests whose Accept header lists only application/json (without also listing text/event-stream), even though the server only returns JSON in that mode. Both PRs diff from the identical base revision of src/server/webStandardStreamableHttp.ts and remove the same AND-based validation that required both media types to be present. (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: 1996 adds a dedicated acceptsMediaType() helper implementing real HTTP content-negotiation parsing: splits multi-entry Accept headers, normalizes case/whitespace, and honors q=0 (explicit rejection) and wildcard media ranges (type/*, */*). 2046 instead does a single acceptHeader?.includes('application/json') substring check, which would incorrectly accept a client sending application/json;q=0 and would not recognize application/* or */* as accepting JSON. Both touch the same call site with similar blast radius, but 1996's parsing is spec-correct where 2046's is a narrower patch covering only the literal-substring case from its linked issue.

The old check would silently never match, causing redundant fallback discovery requests for root-like URLs. #2214 leaves that mismatch unaddressed and is scoped as a 'chore' covering only the cosmetic double-slash edge case. Note #2214 also patches buildDiscoveryUrls' separate inline slash-stripping, which #2215's diff does not touch, so that one hunk should be ported into #2215 before closing #2214.
